name: East Trewent Farm
dogs: Welcome by arrangement, one per cottage
beachAccess: A few minutes' walk to Freshwater East beach
boardStorage: Space to store boats, bikes or surfboards
confirmedFeatures: Wi-Fi, central heating, wood burners in the Granary, Milking Parlour and Cowshed, welcome hamper, ground-floor bedroom, table tennis in the barn, bodyboards guests can borrow, spare wetsuits in various sizes, board and bike storage
overview: East Trewent Farm has four self-catering cottages on Stackpole Road, a few minutes' walk from Freshwater East beach and the coast path. They sleep two to six and come with a welcome hamper. Guests can borrow bodyboards, and spare wetsuits are available if you forget yours. There are wood burners in the Granary, Milking Parlour and Cowshed, and table tennis in the barn.
surfTripFit: Surfboard storage, borrowable bodyboards, spare wetsuits and a short walk to Freshwater East make it one of the most surf-friendly stays here. Manorbier and Freshwater West are both in easy reach, so it works as a base whatever the wind is doing.
